name: magus-disciple-without-the-class-bonus-on-death-does-not-draw
notes: Generated bodies gated these cards' [Class Bonus] with IsClassBonusActive($player) and NO class list, which only checks that the player controls any champion and is therefore always true: every champion got the bonus. IsClassBonusActive() now resolves the bare form against the printed class(es) of the card whose ability closure is running (GAInstallClassBonusSourceWrappers() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php wraps the 32 affected cards' ability closures); a champion matching any of the card's classes satisfies it. Spirit of Fire is neither Cleric nor Mage: no draw on death.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Death: Draw a card.

engineBug.summary: Class Bonus effects applied for every champion (bare IsClassBonusActive($player) is always true).
